quests.title: The Order Calls
text: A village librarian slips you a note: the Arcane Order is recruiting, and the entrance fee is ten books and a quill. Bring them to Archmage Orrin Vael in Reece.

lines: Ten books and a quill! Marvellous. Marvellous! Now where did I put my spectacles?
Ah. On my head. As is traditional.
Magic, apprentice, is the art of knowing precisely what you are doing. Guesswork is for amateurs and goblins.
Schools, spells, scrolls. We shall start at the beginning and end somewhere rather more alarming.
Pip? PIP! Oh, never mind.

rewards.name: Guide to the Schools
lore: Eight schools. Orrin has underlined the dangerous ones.

lines: Psst. The Arcane Order is recruiting, and I'm meant to be discreet about it.
The fee is ten books and a quill. Take them to Archmage Orrin Vael in the library tower in Reece.

quests.title: An Honest Table
text: Orrin despises guesswork. Build an enchanting table ringed by fifteen bookshelves, and enchant your first tool.

tasks.title: Build an enchanting table ringed with bookshelves

quests.title: Reroll the Fates
text: Orrin's test: produce a book with two enchantments he names, using the table's re-roll, without wasting more than ten levels.

lines: Two enchantments on one book. Sharpness and Unbreaking, I think. Or was it Mending? I wrote it down somewhere.
You may re-roll the table. That is what the instrument is for.
But no more than ten levels wasted. Fortune favours the frugal.

tasks.checkmark: I made the book without wasting ten levels

quests.title: The Priest's Blessing
text: Priests of the Order wander between villages. Find one, trade with him for a healing potion and hear about the undead stirring beneath old graves.

lines: Peace, traveller. The Order's work is quiet but never finished.
Something is stirring beneath the old graves. The dead are restless.
Sister Agathe hunts them. She keeps to the crypt under Reece's church, when she's not on the road.
Take a healing draught, for the road. Notch's blessing on you.

quests.title: Ink and Parchment
text: Craft an inscription table, mix common ink, and copy a scroll for the library's records.

quests.title: Essence of the Arcane
text: Break down unwanted scrolls and enchanted gear into arcane essence, and gather twenty: the Order's currency.

quests.title: A Book of One's Own
text: Orrin won't let an untested caster anywhere near the library's rare books. Bind a copper spellbook, inscribe your first spell, and prove your control on a target dummy until it comes cleanly.

tasks.title: Practise on the dummy until it comes cleanly

quests.title: The Study
text: Every mage needs a study. Build one with wisewood bookshelves, a brazier, a pedestal for your book and a scroll rack.

quests.title: The Pyromancer's Tower
text: Orrin's old rival keeps a tower near the badlands. Find the Pyromancer Tower and ask its pyromancer to teach you, politely.

lines: Orrin sent you? That old windbag. Is he still losing his spectacles?
Teach you? Politely, you say. Hm. Most people just throw things at me.
I only teach those who can take a fireball. Prove it.

quests.title: Trial by Fire
text: The pyromancer only teaches those who can take a fireball. Duel him with spells until he yields.

encounter.name: The Pyromancer
lines: Ha! Let's see what the old windbag taught you!
Enough! You've earned it.

quests.title: School of Fire
text: The pyromancer will teach you, once you've earned it. The dead keep clawing out of the old graves around her tower, and only fire lays them to rest for good.
Craft a fire rune, scribe a fire spell, and cleanse twenty of the restless dead with flame.

tasks.title: Lay twenty of the dead to rest with fire

quests.title: The Apothecarist
text: Deep in the mangroves lives the Apothecarist, who trades potions for odd ingredients. Find the hut and trade her a stack of mangrove roots and spider eyes.

lines: Roots and eyes! You've done your reading.
Every ailment has its cure. You only have to know which.
Take this elixir. It'll toughen your skin against sharp things.

quests.title: The Poisoned Traveller
text: A courier staggers out of the swamp, poisoned, withered and slowing by the minute. Keep him alive with what the Apothecarist taught you: brew a cure for each ailment in turn, before the next one sets in.

encounter.name: Poisoned Courier
lines: Help... I drank from the wrong spring... everything hurts...
Poison, then withering, then... I can't feel my legs.
You did it? I'm... I can breathe. Thank you.

tasks.checkmark: I brewed a cure for each ailment

quests.title: Hags' Pantry
text: The Apothecarist won't go near the witches, but she wants their stock. Visit a witch hut and bring back a witch's redstone, glowstone and a bottle of her brew.

item.name: Witch's Brew
item.tooltip: A bottle of her own stock

quests.title: The Lost Apprentice
text: Pip, Orrin's apprentice, ran off with three of his books. Track her to a wizard tower in the old forests, solve the warded door, and talk her into coming home.

lines: Oh. Orrin sent you. Of course he did. Is he cross?
I only borrowed them. All three. They were looking lonely.
This door took me an hour. I'm quite proud of it, actually.
Fine. Fine! I'll go home. But I'm keeping the hat.

quests.title: A Hundred Sparks
text: Orrin is raising a ward of runes around Reece against whatever is draining the old places. Every spell cast by a sworn member of the Order feeds a spark of its echo into the ring.
A hundred sparks will wake it. Cast them anywhere; the ward hears.

tasks.title: Feed the ward a hundred spells
